story_review.one_viewing_summary: Intended chain, from code (not observed): a generic Houston cardiothoracic operating room lights up while its four wall cameras power up and scan. They light in turn and turn to a gurney an attendant wheels to the doorway. Two more attendants wait behind the table, one holding a folded drape. A camera pulse stamps Patient entry on the wall clock as the gurney crosses the threshold. It stamps Draped as two attendants open and lay the drape, and Turnover as the draped patient is wheeled out and a fresh sheet is laid. The next patient is wheeled in and slid across, a new drape is passed and laid, and 'Patient draped' reaches a surgeon's phone. On the records desk the study shows the suite pulling away from other Houston Methodist sites: about 25 more a month, 7 percent, 8.3 to 41.0. Eleven equal placebo units are stamped short of significance, then 'associated, not caused', bundled reviews, a minority stake and future work tagging turnover. The film closes on a blank turnover box beside the clock and a card of about 25 more a month linked to the rollout, with the camera lamps still lit.
story_review.opening_to_ending: It opens on cameras visibly powering up and watching people move a patient, which poses the question 'add surgeries, or only count them?'. It answers at s7 (about 25 more, associated, not caused) and closes on the open turnover box beside the 25-case result card in the same room, the cameras still watching. The causal arc holds, and the agents of every physical step are now believable whole figures.
story_review.weakest_transition: s3-shot-1 to s3-shot-2 (14.66 s). The drape handoff from C to B and A straddles the cut, from the small vignette beside the phone to the medium room, with about 0.14 s where the moving bundle is between hands. It is unresolved until phone pixels exist.
